note: Held-out split for the eval. heldOut is frozen before any prompt or threshold tuning; once frozenAt is set, cases only get added, never moved. The first four held-out cases are public photos without a scale reference: they test that the pipeline refuses to invent millimetres. Seven team photos (coin in the crack's plane) were added 2026-10-30 as the first scale cases; DSC_0684 and DSC_0685 are the same crack at two distances and stay in dev together, so held-out has no near-duplicates. None of the seven has a measured length yet, so accuracy on them stays UNSCORED until someone puts a tape on the wall. Photo files stay local in fixtures/photos/ (gitignored); source and license are recorded here.
